question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **when**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **When** can be used in the following ways:

 
 
• as a **conjunction** (connecting two clauses)
 
• as a **question adverb** (introducing a direct or indirect question)
 
• as a **relative adverb **(referring back to a noun and introducing a relative clause)
 
 
 
• In the given context, when is used as a **conjunction **in order to join two clauses.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 2 is **option 1**.
